accepted_changes: 88 selected daily Hong Kong phrase weights, 109 appended exact-code rows; capped public Rime dictionary weights, not newly measured chat frequencies
Code-aligned local bigram/trigram learning from explicit whole-candidate and Single selections, used in sentence lattice and character ranking
At most four additional context-favored exact dictionary characters beyond the usual 24 candidates per lattice step; unchanged beam of 48
Specific-context rejection overrides shorter positive history; reselection withdraws the corresponding positive sequence event, explicit corrections reject only changed contexts
No full private sentence keys, corpus model retraining, Fold7 layout or signing changes

single_learning_simulation.method: Three passes of explicit per-character selections across the same 32 authored cases using actual SingleSelectionHistory and PhraseLearning; both arms share identical legacy character/known-word counts and RecentLearning weights. Contextual arm additionally receives the selected short sequence records. No full sentence key created.
single_learning_simulation.limitation: Replaying explicitly selected examples measures personalization, not generalization or unseen real-user accuracy; all contexts are empty initially.

privacy.default: Learning off by default; protected/password/noLearning fields produce no learning records
privacy.sequence_storage: S:<typed character code>:<one or two previous Han characters>:<selected Han character>, stored locally in existing learning preferences
privacy.temporal_weight: Existing lifetime counts plus bounded recent component, seven-day half-life
privacy.clear_learning: Existing clear-learning action clears positive, recent and rejection stores, including new S records
privacy.migration: Existing Q/C/W/E records retained; character pruning excludes new S records

wordshk.useful_for: Hong Kong expressions, definitions and attested example combinations
wordshk.access_observed: Homepage returned HTTP 403; public AlienKevin/wordshk-tools README documents the official CSV access request
wordshk.license: MIT tool license is not taken as permission to reuse original dictionary data; confirm data terms before import

signing_safeguard_tests.environment: Configured Java 17 and Gradle cache activated before running tools/test_signing.py

limits: Small no-history authored top-5/top-20 gain; no first-choice gain or conversational target-rank gain measured without personal history.
Three lower candidate lists changed across the 600 conversation cases, while first candidates and target ranks all remained unchanged.
Short learned sequences cannot guarantee every wanted sentence enters the bounded search or becomes first; repeated explicit selections may be needed.
No Android editor/Fold7 device or device-latency validation in this cloud run.
